About Kevin's

Kevin'sSports Bar

Where the locals go. Since 1985.

Our Story

About Us

In 1985 a sports-obsessed local named Kevin had one idea: build the ultimate place to watch the game with your people. Great food, cold drinks, every game on, and a room where every fan feels at home.

In 1990 he went bigger, with more screens, more seats and the same spirit of camaraderie that turned a small sports bar into a second home for St. Pete fans.

Today Kevin's is still family owned and still built on that original vision. When you cheer for your team here, you're not just watching a game. You're part of the story.

Rays Country · St. Petersburg

Tropicana
Field

Tropicana Field opened in 1990, the same year Kevin's went bigger, and the Rays have given St. Pete plenty to cheer about, from World Series runs in 2008 and 2020 to every walk-off in between.

When Hurricane Milton tore the roof off the Trop in October 2024, the Rays spent the 2025 season across the bay in Tampa. On April 6, 2026, after 561 days away, they came home. Game day is back in St. Pete, and so is the pregame and the postgame at Kevin's.

Our History

Four Decades of Game Days

From one man's dream of the perfect gathering place to a St. Pete landmark, Kevin's has always been about community, cold beer, and a whole lot of fun.

  1. 1985

    The Doors Open

    Kevin opens a small neighborhood sports bar built around great food, cold drinks and the big game.

  2. 1990

    Kevin Goes Bigger

    Bigger screens, more seats and the same camaraderie turn Kevin's into the ultimate fan experience.

  3. Today

    Still Family Owned

    Nearly four decades later, Kevin's legacy lives on, with live music on weekends and every game on.

Every Game. Every Screen.

Grab a stool at the bar, pull a table together with the crew, and settle in. If it's on, it's on at Kevin's.

Come Experience It Yourself

Great food, cold drinks and every game on, right here in St. Petersburg. Whether it's a Rays game day or any day, there's always a reason to stop by Kevin's.
